title: 第十八章 继续猛第十九章 穿着捷达外套的悍马
content_zh:
——疯皇高级会所。
偌大的牌匾，挂在南城区一栋六层高的独楼的门梁上，这里是疯彪势力的根据地，这家会所是疯彪他自己的产业，其中实行多元化的经营理念，集酒吧、KTV、舞厅、桑拿洗浴、桌球室等为一体的休闲娱乐场所。
黑色的吉普车和面包车先后开进了会所后院的停车场，车上的小弟们渐次下来，再没人敢去招惹林昆，林昆自己从车上下来，对着明媚的阳光伸了个懒腰。
一行人从会所的后门进入，进门后先是一段昏暗的长廊，走了一会儿后来到了前厅，光线一下子明亮了起来，十多个人分两拨坐电梯到三楼，到了三楼后，阿狗吩咐几个小弟带林昆去旁边的一间会议室，他自己则向走廊的另一个方向走去。
疯彪正坐在办公室的沙发上，右手捏着一根拇指粗下的雪茄，左手握着一杯颜色精纯的红酒，办公室的门被敲响了，他淡淡的说了一句：“进来吧。”
阿狗推门进来，刚一进门脚底下就突然一虚，整个人踉跄的就向前栽倒，好在他扶住了门把手才没摔倒，但此时他却再也忍不住了，捂着胸口就剧烈的咳嗽起来，随着每次咳嗽，都有新鲜的血液从嘴里喷出来。
疯彪微微一皱眉，放下了红酒跟雪茄，起身向阿狗走了过来，“那小子下的手？”
阿狗抬起头，面色惨白的点点头。
疯彪皱眉道：“看到你的短信，还以为你言重了，没想到……他几招把你打成这样的？”
阿狗面有羞愧，竖起一根手指道：“一脚。”
疯彪的眉头皱的更深了，喃喃道：“还真是个高手呢……”
阿狗道：“绝对不比阿豹差。”
“嗯……”疯彪沉吟一声，扶着阿狗坐下，道：“看来，之前调查这小子还不够彻底，要就是一个普通当兵的，绝对不会有这身手的。”
阿狗惭愧道：“都是我的错，没有调查清楚。”
“这个不怨你，要真是大有来头的人物，又怎会轻易的被调查出来。中港市最近这两年太平静了，也没来过什么狠角色，这小子怕是个过江龙啊。”
疯彪站了起来，道：“阿狗，你先在这休息，我去会会这条过江龙。”
“彪哥，千万小心。”
“嗯。”疯彪转身出门。
这是一间相当宽敞的会议室，除了宽敞之外，别的可以说是一无是处，不管是布置、装修还是其中的桌椅板凳，都像是从二手市场里淘来的。
林昆仰躺着坐在一张椅子上，两只脚抬起来放在办公桌上，兀自的点了根烟叼上。门口一字排开站着那十多个小弟，但看这十多个小弟的脸上，全都是一副如临大敌的表情，看向林昆的眼神就像是在看凶兽。

吱……
办公室的门被从外面推开了，门口站着的小弟们，马上齐刷刷的喊了声彪哥。
看着迎面走过来坐下的疤脸男，林昆知道主要人物出现了，嘴角露出一抹笑意。
见到林昆第一眼，疯彪不由的暗皱眉头，要不是事先知道这小子很有两下子，就他现在这一副吊儿郎当的表情，非把他当成了市井小混混不可。
不等疯彪靠口，林昆先说话了，他笑了一声问道：“就是你要见我？”
疯彪淡淡一笑，道：“不错。”
林昆直接问道：“什么事？”
疯彪也不拐弯抹角，直言道：“你打了我的人，请你来是让你给我一个说法。”
林昆眉头轻轻一蹙，旋即微笑了起来，也不问哪个被打的是疯彪的人，直接道：“你想要什么说法？”
疯彪冷冷一笑，道：“按照我的规矩，先废了你的手脚，再丢到海里喂鱼。”
“呵呵……”
content_en:
——The Crazy King’s high-end club.
A huge plaque hangs on the door beam of a six-story single-story building in Nancheng District, which is the base of Feng Biao's influence. This club is Feng Biao's own industry. It implements a diversified business philosophy and is a leisure and entertainment venue integrating bars, KTV, dance halls, saunas, billiards rooms, etc.
The black jeep and van drove into the parking lot in the backyard of the club one after another. The boys in the car gradually got out, and no one dared to provoke Lin Kun. Lin Kun got out of the car and stretched in the bright sunshine.
A group of people entered from the back door of the club. After entering, they first entered a dark corridor. After walking for a while, they arrived at the front hall. The light suddenly became brighter. More than ten people took the elevator to the third floor in two groups. After reaching the third floor, Agou asked a few boys to take Lin Kun to a conference room next to it, while he himself walked in the other direction of the corridor.
Crazy Biao was sitting on the sofa in the office, holding a cigar as thick as his thumb in his right hand, and a glass of pure red wine in his left hand. There was a knock on the office door, and he said lightly: "Come in."
Agou pushed the door open and came in. As soon as he entered, he suddenly felt weak under his feet. He stumbled forward and fell forward. Fortunately, he held on to the door handle to prevent him from falling. But at this time, he couldn't help it anymore. He covered his chest and coughed violently. With every cough, fresh blood spurted out of his mouth.
Crazy Biao frowned slightly, put down the red wine and cigar, stood up and walked towards Ah Gou, "What did that kid do?"
Agou raised his head and nodded with a pale face.
Crazy Biao frowned and said, "When I saw your text message, I thought you were being harsh, but I didn't expect...how many tricks did he beat you like this?"
Agou looked ashamed, raised a finger and said: "Kick."
Crazy Biao's frown deepened and he murmured: "He is really a master..."
Ah Gou said: "Definitely no worse than Ah Bao."
"Hmm..." Crazy Biao groaned, helped Ah Gou sit down, and said, "It seems that the previous investigation of this kid was not thorough enough. If he is an ordinary soldier, he will never have such skills."
Agou said ashamedly: "It's all my fault. I didn't investigate clearly."
"I don't blame you for this. If he is really a well-connected person, how could he be easily investigated? Zhonggang City has been too peaceful in the past two years, and there haven't been any ruthless characters. I'm afraid this kid is a dragon who has crossed the river."
Crazy Biao stood up and said: "Agou, you rest here first, I'll go meet this dragon crossing the river."
"Brother Biao, be careful."
"Yeah." Crazy Biao turned around and went out.
This is a quite spacious conference room. Apart from its spaciousness, it can be said to be useless in other aspects. Whether it is the layout, decoration or the tables, chairs and benches, they all look like they were found in the second-hand market.
Lin Kun was lying on his back on a chair, with his feet raised on the desk, and he lit a cigarette and held it in his mouth. There were more than ten young men standing in a row at the door, but looking at the faces of these more than ten young men, they all looked like they were facing an enemy. They looked at Lin Kun like he was looking at a ferocious beast.
squeak...
The door of the office was pushed open from the outside, and the boys standing at the door immediately shouted "Brother Biao" in unison.
Looking at the scar-faced man coming towards him and sitting down, Lin Kun knew that the main character had appeared, and a smile appeared on his lips.
When he saw Lin Kun for the first time, Kuang Biao couldn't help but frown secretly. If he hadn't known in advance that this kid was very capable, with his careless expression now, he would have been mistaken for a street gangster.
Before Crazy Biao could respond, Lin Kun spoke first. He laughed and asked, "You want to see me?"
Crazy Biao smiled lightly and said, "Not bad."
Lin Kun asked directly: "What's the matter?"
Crazy Biao didn't mince words and said bluntly: "You hit my man, please come here and let me give you an explanation."
Lin Kun frowned slightly,Immediately he smiled, and without asking which of the beaten people was Crazy Biao, he said directly: "What explanation do you want?"
Crazy Biao smiled coldly and said: "According to my rules, I will cripple your hands and feet first, and then throw them into the sea to feed the fish."
"Haha..."
